title: fix(workspace-state): account for packageConfigs overrides in verifyDepsBeforeRun (pnpm/pnpm#15545)
body: ## Summary Closes pnpm/pnpm#15545. In workspaces configured with dedicated per-project lockfiles (`sharedWorkspaceLockfile: false`) and project-specific settings under `packageConfigs` (such as `overrides`), `pnpm install` anchors each project's configuration via `anchor_dedicated_project` and records the project's effective settings in its workspace state. However, `check_deps_status_before_run_at` previously validated the project state using the unanchored root workspace configuration. This caused `first_setting_drift` to flag settings such as `overrides` as drifted immediately after installation when running scripts or commands (`ERR_PNPM_VERIFY_DEPS_BEFORE_RUN`). This PR anchors the configuration for dedicated projects in `check_deps_status_before_run_at` using `anchor_dedicated_project` before loading and verifying workspace state. ## Squash Commit Body When a workspace uses dedicated per-project lockfiles (`sharedWorkspaceLockfile: false`) and defines project-specific settings under `packageConfigs` (such as `overrides`), `pnpm install` anchors the project configuration via `anchor_dedicated_project` and records the project's effective settings in its workspace state. However, `check_deps_status_before_run_at` previously validated the project state using the unanchored root workspace configuration. This caused `first_setting_drift` to flag settings such as `overrides` as drifted immediately after installation when running scripts or commands. Anchor the configuration for dedicated projects in `check_deps_status_before_run_at` before loading and verifying workspace state. Closes pnpm/pnpm#15545. ## Checklist - [x] I checked the referenced issue and verified that none of the PRs already linked to it solves it. - [x] New features are implemented only in the Rust pnpm v12 CLI. Bug fixes are implemented in every affected version. - [x] Added a changeset (`pnpm changeset`) if this PR changes any published package. - [x] Added or updated tests. --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. Autofix is disabled. ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Bug Fixes** * Dependency verification before running scripts now respects project-specific package configuration overrides in workspaces with separate lockfiles. Projects with unchanged overrides continue to run, while mismatched overrides are reported.
